expenditures.detail: A TRACED +0.29 delta, retained verbatim and not nudged, and it is a COVER-ROUNDING difference, not a missing or double-counted row. THE SCHEDULE ITSELF CLOSES TO THE CENT AT EVERY LEVEL. p5's 17 rows sum to 63.07 + 100 + 4 + 29.78 + 100 + 54.61 + 57.73 + 664.80 + 3032.11 + 650 + 40 + 275 + 50 + 1886.97 + 2000 + 69.29 + 1389 = 10,466.36 = its printed 'Subtotal for this page' 10,466 ³⁶ exactly. p6's 17 rows sum to 250 + 65 + 178.82 + 3000 + 53 + 152.53 + 27.12 + 35.70 + 13.75 + 506.25 + 25.99 + 225.74 + 1886.97 + 46.35 + 30 + 198 + 157.71 = 6,852.93 = its printed subtotal 6,852 ⁹³ exactly. 10,466.36 + 6,852.93 = 17,319.29 = Schedule B's own printed grand total (17,319 ²⁹, confirmed at 600 dpi). THE COVER PRINTS 17,319 WITH NO CENTS, and the whole p2 Summary Page is written in whole dollars — lines 1-7 and both Column B cells all carry round figures (16,080 / 46,320 / 17,319 / 40,071 / 7,488 / 23,568 / 6,249), and a 900 dpi crop of the line-2 Column A cell (pct:55,44,25,6@p2) rendered '17,319' beside Column B '40,071' with no raised cents anywhere in the cell. So the 0.29 is the filer's own rounding convention on the summary page, traced to that page, and the itemized sum is reported against it honestly rather than being trimmed to match. NOTE the contribution side has no such gap because every contribution figure on this filing is already a whole dollar.

in_kind_convention: MONETARY-PLUS-IN-KIND — the convention that closed, and it had to be tested. This filer books in-kind INSIDE Column A on BOTH sides. On contributions, p4's last entry is captioned 'In Kind donation from Reagan outdoor Digital Signs' 1,389 and is inside p4's own printed 9,039 subtotal; drop it and the side sums to 14,691 against a stated 16,080, so monetary-only FAILS by exactly 1,389. On expenditures the mirror entries are 'In Kind expense Reagan Signs' 1,389 (p5 row 17), 'In Kind expense used Taylor Audio' 250 and 'In Kind expense used other' 65 (p6 rows 1-2), all inside their pages' printed subtotals; drop them and the side sums to 15,615.29 against a schedule total of 17,319.29, short by exactly 1,704. Both conventions were computed before the verdict. This is a further confirmation that IN-KIND TREATMENT IS PER FILER, not a property of the utah form family, and the first 2014 instance in this chunk.

notes: THE LARGEST FILING OF THIS CHUNK: 6 pages, 25 contribution rows over two Schedule A sheets and 34 expenditure rows over two Schedule B sheets. Page kinds classified from their own printed headings: p1 cover (2014 county blank), p2 'SUMMARY PAGE', p3 + p4 'SCHEDULE A — ITEMIZED CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED', p5 + p6 'SCHEDULE B — ITEMIZED EXPENDITURES MADE'. PAGE-FACE candidate: the cover's Name field reads 'Bill Lee' while the Report Verification print-name line reads 'William C Lee' — the same person under a familiar and a formal form, recorded here rather than adjudicated; index.csv names no candidate. Office written on the page as 'Utah County Commissioner (Seat B)', which the filer DID print, so it agrees with the channel's 'County Commission Seat B' and no seat is being inferred. Republican; Pleasant Grove. Report type ticked 'Seven days preceding the General Election'; amendment 'No' ticked; signed 10/28/2014; clerk's date stamp 'OCT 28 PM 3:55'. FOLIATION — a SECOND 2014 practice, contradicting the first filing of this chunk: this filer numbers his sheets 'Page 2 of 6' … 'Page 6 of 6' and therefore COUNTS THE COVER, whereas Buhman's same-cycle filing numbers 'Page 1 of 3' … '3 of 3' and EXCLUDES it. Two practices, same cycle, same form — foliation still cannot locate a page. MULTI-PAGE SCHEDULE CONVENTION (useful for the remaining 2014 filings): on a two-sheet schedule this filer fills 'Subtotal for this page' on BOTH sheets but leaves 'Total … Received' as a DASH on the first sheet and writes the grand total only on the LAST sheet. A blank grand-total cell on a non-final schedule page is therefore correct use of the form, not a missing figure. PRIVACY: this filing is NOT redacted (no '_Redacted' suffix; the county published the candidate's own address block in the clear) — and the 'Address, City & Zip' column is EMPTY on all four schedule pages because THE FILER left it blank, which is a different fact from a county redaction and is recorded as such; no donor_city/donor_state exists to carry. DATES: month/day with NO YEAR on 58 of the 59 rows; kept verbatim, never completed from the report date. IN-KIND: booked inline in Column A on both sides — see in_kind_convention; this is the chunk's first 2014 in-kind filer and it required the monetary-plus-in-kind convention to close. THE 0.29: the expenditure side is a TRACED delta because the cover rounds to whole dollars while Schedule B carries cents — see recon.expenditures; nothing was nudged and both figures are named.
